description: How do Null keys group and order: GROUP BY g, GROUP BY h and GROUP BY g, h over GA (Null in each) with Count(*), Count of a Null-bearing column and Sum; the same keys listed in the other order with ORDER BY; DISTINCT over two keys and over one with ORDER BY DESC; ORDER BY an aggregate; Min/Max/First/Last per group; and GROUP BY over JA.a and over a LEFT JOIN with Count(JB.b)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
